answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered machinist lathe file with machinists verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 654 aliases would need 654 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the lantern of the check, count the hollow of the cost, and read the summit of the history before any answer is graded. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
